description: This file defines the class ExampleAppWidgetProvider, which extends AppWidgetProvider. It manages an Android app widget's lifecycle events such as updates, deletion, enabling, and disabling. The class includes logic for registering broadcast receivers for time and timezone changes, updating the widget UI, and handling preferences related to the widget.

classes.name: ExampleAppWidgetProvider
classes.description: A class that extends AppWidgetProvider to manage the lifecycle and update events of an Android home screen widget. It handles creating, updating, deleting, enabling, and disabling the widget, and manages broadcast receivers for time-related changes.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Called when the widget needs to be updated; it updates all widget instances with the latest data.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Called when the widget is deleted; cleans up associated preferences.

methods.name: onEnabled
methods.description: Called when the first widget instance is added; registers broadcast receivers for time zone and time changes.

methods.name: onDisabled
methods.description: Called when the last widget instance is removed; unregisters broadcast receivers.

methods.name: updateAppWidget
methods.description: Static method to update a specific widget instance's RemoteViews with current data and display text.
